title: Equal pipe tee

description.en: An equal tee of 20 mm tube with a 2 mm wall: the run lies along the X axis, 80 mm long and centred on the origin (X from -40 to 40); the branch rises along +Z from the run's axis to Z = 40. The bores of run and branch meet inside. Make it with cylinders and booleans. Drive it by the variables pipe_d, wall, run and branch.
description.nl: Een gelijk T-stuk van buis van 20 mm met een wand van 2 mm: de doorloop ligt langs de X-as, 80 mm lang en gecentreerd op de oorsprong (X van -40 tot 40); de aftakking gaat langs +Z van de as van de doorloop tot Z = 40. De boringen van doorloop en aftakking komen binnenin samen. Maak het met cilinders en booleaanse bewerkingen. Stuur het met de variabelen pipe_d, wall, run en branch.

variables.name: pipe_d
variables.meaning: outside diameter of run and branch

variables.name: run
variables.meaning: length of the run along X

variables.name: branch
variables.meaning: height of the branch's end above the run's axis

expect.value: 2 * pi * (pipe_d / 2) * (run + branch) - 8 * (pipe_d / 2)^2 + 2 * pi * (pipe_d / 2 - wall) * (run + branch) - 8 * (pipe_d / 2 - wall)^2 + 3 * pi * ((pipe_d / 2)^2 - (pipe_d / 2 - wall)^2)

value: (pi * (pipe_d / 2)^2 * branch^2 / 2 - 3 * pi * (pipe_d / 2)^4 / 8 - pi * (pipe_d / 2 - wall)^2 * branch^2 / 2 + 3 * pi * (pipe_d / 2 - wall)^4 / 8) / ((pi * (pipe_d / 2)^2 * (run + branch) - 8 / 3 * (pipe_d / 2)^3) - (pi * (pipe_d / 2 - wall)^2 * (run + branch) - 8 / 3 * (pipe_d / 2 - wall)^3))

derivation: Two cylinders of equal radius R at right angles share a Steinmetz bicylinder of volume 16 R^3 / 3; the branch starts on the run's axis, so it shares half of it, 8 R^3 / 3. The outside is pi R^2 (run + branch) - 8 R^3/3, the bore the same with r = R - wall, and the tee is the outside less the bore (the bore lies inside the outside).

Area: on each cylinder the part inside the other has area 4 R^2 (for the branch: int R sqrt(R^2 - R^2 sin^2) = R^2 int |cos| = 4 R^2; the same for the half of the run under the branch). Outside 2 pi R (run + branch) - 8 R^2, bore likewise with r, plus three end rings pi (R^2 - r^2).

Centroid Z: the branch cylinder's moment pi R^2 branch^2/2 less the shared half bicylinder's, int over the disc x^2 + y^2 <= R^2 of (R^2 - y^2)/2 = 3 pi R^4 / 8; the same for the bore, subtracted. X and Y are 0 by symmetry.
Two equal cylinders meet in curves that cross each other: a classic hard case for a boolean.
